title: 第3章 仙尊不可辱第4章 收获颇丰木灵精
lines: “什么叫反悔？”
“明明是你狮子大开口，就算报警，你这也属于讹诈！”
魏佳怡继续娇蛮无理：“再说了，谁知道你是不是碰巧撞运气，刚才是这位医生先治疗的，或许这份功劳属于他呢？”
“对对对，肯定是这样。”
旁边的眼镜男跳出来叫嚣：“我是医科大学的研究生，有医职证件，刚刚是我先治疗的。”
“魏小姐，魏老先生，这死瘸子一看就是无赖，这是我的功劳，肯定是我的治疗有了成效，然后被他中途截胡。”
魏洪林张张嘴巴，他也有些懵。
但随后，包括他在内的所有人，突然感受到了一股摄人心魄的寒意。
“很好，非常好！”
“违背承诺在先，忘恩负义在后，真是好一个魏家大小姐，好一个豪门家风！”
唐明面色冰冷下来，眼眸中精芒闪烁。
眼镜男翘着脑袋，嗤笑出声：“嗤，你一个死瘸子赶紧滚蛋吧，魏老先生明明是我救好的，魏小姐都承认了，你……”
不等他话说完，唐明反手一巴掌抡过去。
眼镜男半边脸肿起来，眼镜框架都被打断。
“你敢打我，你他妈一个死瘸子敢打我！”
眼镜男怒火燃烧，捏着拳头冲上来。
唐明一把摁住眼镜男后脑勺，压下来，同时膝盖狠狠往上顶。
眼镜男满面桃花开，张嘴吐出满口血牙。
但这仅仅是开始。
嘭！嘭！嘭！
唐明单手掐着眼镜男的咽喉，一下一下的撞击车厢墙壁。
没几下，眼镜男疼得嚎哭起来，满头鲜血看起来很是恐怖。
“别打了，别打了。”
“我错了，我没有救助魏老先生，我的学历证件都是伪造的，我也不会什么中医……”
“求求你别打了，再打要出人命了。”
眼镜男嚎哭起来，并且自爆学历证件都是假的。
唐明将其丢在地上，居高临下看着他：“刚才你和我打赌，现在你输了，也准备赖账？”
眼镜男之前说，唐明若是能救好魏洪林，就跪下来叫爷爷。
“不敢不敢。”
眼镜男赶紧跪下来，磕头喊道：“爷爷，孙子我错了，孙子我不该嚣张，我……”
“跪就跪，乱认什么亲，你还没资格当我孙子。”
content_en:
"What does regret mean?"
"It's obviously you, the lion, who opened the mouth. Even if you call the police, it's still blackmail!"
Wei Jiayi continued to be coquettish and unreasonable: "Besides, who knows if you just happened to be lucky. It was this doctor who treated me first just now. Maybe this credit belongs to him?"
"Yes, yes, that's for sure."
The man with glasses next to him jumped out and shouted: "I am a graduate student at a medical university and have a medical certificate. I was the one who treated him first just now."
"Miss Wei, Mr. Wei, this damn cripple looks like a scoundrel at first glance. This is all my fault. My treatment must have been effective, and he cut him off midway."
Wei Honglin opened his mouth, he was also a little confused.
But then, everyone, including him, suddenly felt a soul-stirring chill.
"Very good, very good!"
"Breaking the promise comes first, being ungrateful comes second. What a wonderful young lady of the Wei family, and what a rich family tradition!"
Tang Ming's face turned cold and his eyes flickered.
The man with glasses tilted his head and sneered: "Hey, you are a cripple, so get out of here. I obviously saved Mr. Wei, and Miss Wei even admitted it, you..."
Before he could finish his words, Tang Ming slapped him with his backhand.
"Pah——"
Half of the bespectacled man's face was swollen, and the frames of his glasses were broken.
"You dare to hit me, you fucking lame dare to hit me!"
The man with glasses was furious and rushed forward with clenched fists.
Tang Ming pressed the back of the bespectacled man's head and pushed him down while pushing his knees hard up.
"Ah!"
The bespectacled man's face was full of peach blossoms, and he opened his mouth and spat out a mouth full of bloody teeth.
But this is just the beginning.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Tang Ming grabbed the bespectacled man's throat with one hand and banged against the wall of the carriage.
After a few moments, the man with glasses started to cry out in pain. His head was covered in blood and he looked very scary.
"Stop fighting, stop fighting."
"I was wrong. I didn't help Mr. Wei. My academic certificates were all forged, and I don't know anything about Chinese medicine..."
"Please stop fighting. If you fight again, someone will die."
The man with glasses burst into tears and revealed that his academic qualifications were all fake.
Tang Ming threw it on the ground and looked at him condescendingly: "You made a bet with me just now, and now that you've lost, are you going to refuse?"
The man with glasses said before that if Tang Ming could save Wei Honglin, he would kneel down and call him grandpa.
"Don't dare."
The man with glasses quickly knelt down, kowtowed and shouted: "Grandpa, grandson, I was wrong. Grandson, I shouldn't be arrogant. I..."
"Kneel down and kneel down. You are not qualified to be my grandson."
title_en: Chapter 3 The Immortal Lord cannot be insulted Chapter 4 Harvest a lot of wood spirits
